intro_text: Here's everything between now and getting your keys. A lot of these dates don't exist yet, and that's normal this early. I'll fill them in as they land, so check back whenever you want to know where things stand.

key_dates.label: Closing
key_dates.sub: At Platinum Title, keys at funding

milestones.label: Earnest money delivered
milestones.note: $12,000 to Continental Title, online or by check dropped at one of their offices. Sarah sent the instructions.

milestones.label: Inspection period
milestones.note: Every inspection needs to be done and sent to the sellers by this date. Pick your inspector and I'll get it all scheduled.

milestones.label: Homeowners insurance secured
milestones.note: Send the policy to your lender once it's bound.

milestones.label: Appraisal
milestones.note: Tanner orders this after the inspection period ends.

milestones.label: Clear to close
milestones.note: The lender's final sign-off. Once this comes in, we're basically there.

milestones.label: Review your closing disclosure
milestones.note: Your final numbers. Read it when it lands and send me anything that looks off.

milestones.label: Utilities set up in your name
milestones.note: Evergy, Kansas Gas Service, WaterONE, Johnson County Wastewater, and trash (KC Disposal or another provider).

milestones.label: Final walkthrough
milestones.note: Usually the day before or the morning of closing. We'll make sure the house is in the same shape you remember it.

milestones.label: Closing
milestones.note: Platinum Title, 10895 Lowell Ave, Suite 120, Overland Park (APEX 2 Building). Time TBD. Plan on 45 minutes to an hour.
milestones.location: Platinum Title, 10895 Lowell Ave Suite 120, Overland Park, KS 66210

checklist_items: Lock in homeowners insurance and send the policy to your lender
Don't open new credit, change jobs, or make big purchases until after closing
Answer lender requests quickly. Underwriting moves at the speed of your inbox
Schedule gas, electric, water, trash, and internet to start in your name on Dec 31
Review your closing disclosure as soon as it arrives and send me any questions
Never act on wiring instructions sent by email. Call Platinum Title at 913-491-5001 to confirm before sending a dime
Bring a photo ID to closing
Plan the move for after you have keys, not before
note_text: Dates are estimates and can shift with lender, appraisal, and title timelines. I'll update this page as things move, so there's no need to track any of this yourself.
